Desktop builds for macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel), Windows, and Linux.
See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/KenDev099/yande-dl/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for what changed.

⚠️ These builds are **unsigned** (code signing arrives in a later release):

- **macOS** — right-click the app → **Open** → confirm. If Gatekeeper still blocks it, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/yande-dl.app`.
- **Windows** — SmartScreen may warn: click **More info** → **Run anyway**.
